name: Citrus-Fire Grilled Half Chicken with Mexican Rice
whyItWorks: Juicy fire-grilled chicken breast meat paired with well-steamed Mexican white or seasoned rice delivers lean protein and gentle carbs without greasy batter or inflammatory sauces.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel off and discard the charred spiced chicken skin. Eat tender white meat with seasoned rice and warm corn tortillas. Skip refried beans.
